description: This PHP source file renders the web-based user interface for displaying software information and version details of a Gateway device. It includes header, navigation, and footer components, and gathers device info using backend functions to display in HTML format.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from the device's configuration database based on a provided key.

methods.name: get_wan_type
methods.description: Determines the type of WAN connection (e.g., EPON, DSL) for conditional logic in display.
